_comment: Volumetric cloud knobs. LOOK knobs are also pushed live from the lab Clouds tab; these are the startup defaults. PERF knobs (raymarch_steps, temporal_frames) are read by CloudVolume (C#). Dome resolution is a launch param (--cloudtex), not a live knob. Default coverage 0.55 (~50% sky fill on the round-2 weather curve, mean ~0.56).
